chunks.title: VakıfBank (VakıfBank) COP31 Role & Commitments
chunks.text: VakıfBank is a Turkish State Bank headquartered in Türkiye. At UNFCCC COP31 in Antalya (November 9-20, 2026), its verified role is: Official COP31 Main Partner; channeling $500M ADB green/inclusive SME financing agreement signed at COP31. Verified COP31 2026 climate finance commitment: $500M ADB long-term financing facility signed at COP31 for SMEs in less-developed & earthquake-affected provinces plus women entrepreneurs. Source verification: https://www.trtworld.com/article/08c7af154347.

chunks.title: VakıfBank Financing Instruments & Ticket Bounds
chunks.text: VakıfBank provides the following climate financing instruments: ADB-Backed Green SME Loan, Sustainable Transition Loan, Women Entrepreneur Green Facility, Green Bond Proceeds Loan. Typical transaction ticket range is USD 50,000 to USD 75,000,000. Eligible applicant profiles include: SME, Mid-Cap Enterprise, Large Corporate, Women/Youth Entrepreneur.

chunks.title: VakıfBank Priority Climate Sectors & Regional Mandate
chunks.text: Priority climate sectors funded by VakıfBank: SME Green Transition, Climate Adaptation & Resilience, Renewable Energy, Energy Efficiency, Women-Led Green Enterprise. Target geographic focus includes: Türkiye. Projects outside primary regions or ticket bounds may require syndicated or on-lending structures.

chunks.title: VakıfBank Mandatory Form & Underwriting Requirements
chunks.text: Mandatory requirements to complete VakıfBank's application form: Turkish SME/corporate registration (VKN); ADB sub-loan E&S screening & inclusive priority verification (region / women ownership); Green investment purpose & energy/resilience benefit statement; Financial statements & collateral/KGF guarantee. Explicit exclusion rules: ADB Safeguards Prohibited Investment Activities List. Official application portal: https://www.vakifbank.com.tr/en/sustainability.

chunks.title: VakıfBank Form Template: Turkish Commercial / State Bank Sustainable & Green Transformation Loan Application
chunks.text: VakıfBank uses the 'Turkish Commercial / State Bank Sustainable & Green Transformation Loan Application' workflow governed by BRSA (BDDK) Sustainable Banking Guidelines, Turkish Green Taxonomy & EU CBAM Readiness. Typical review timeline is 1–4 weeks (Branch/Corporate RM Intake -> Green Eligibility Check -> Credit Approval). Form sections required: 1. Applicant Identification, 2. Product Selection, 3. Green Technical Criteria, 4. Credit & Collateral, 5. Compliance, 6. Summary.
